data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Foundations of AI Tokenomics — Dual-View Production Functions, Token Taxonomy, and Shadow Pricing
data.description: Unified economic and physical framework for AI Tokenomics on Google Cloud, synthesizing Zhu (2026) hardware-level token footprint decomposition with Chen et al. (2026) agentic token lifecycle, triple economic attributes, nested CES production functions, and Micro/Meso/Macro shadow pricing in Google ADK 2.0 and Vertex AI.
